India's Tax Filing Season Begins, With New Forms and Rules

The Indian government has introduced new forms and rules for tax filing, including a mandatory secondary address field. The move aims to improve taxpayer compliance and reduce errors. However, the changes have raised questions about the complexity of the process and its impact on small businesses.
